scripts.name: STRATUS - GCP - Steal and Use the GCE Default Service Account Token from Outside Google Cloud
scripts.description:
Stratus Red Team cloud adversary-emulation technique for GCP.

Steal and Use the GCE Default Service Account Token from Outside Google Cloud

Simulates the theft and use of GCE default service account credentials from outside of Google Cloud. When a GCE instance is created, it is assigned a default service account ({project-number}-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com). If an attacker gains access to the instance (for example through an SSRF vulnerability, a compromised SSH key, or a command injection), they can extract the OAuth2 access token from the instance metadata service and use it from outside of Google Cloud. Warm-up: - Crea

Morgana executes the official Stratus technique using an isolated MORGANA_TEST_ID correlation ID. Prerequisite infrastructure is handled by Stratus warmup. Cleanup uses the same correlation ID.
scripts.command:
# Stratus Red Team — Steal and Use the GCE Default Service Account Token from Outside Google Cloud
# Correlation ID = Morgana Test ID for Detection Fabric correlation
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-$(uuidgen 2>/dev/null || cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid 2>/dev/null || echo manual)}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if [ -n "#{stratus_gcp_project}" ]; then export GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT="#{stratus_gcp_project}"; fi

# Select Stratus binary for this Agent OS
if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
  chmod +x "$STRATUS_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "[INFO] Stratus Red Team: technique=gcp.initial-access.use-compute-sa-outside-gcp"
echo "[INFO] Correlation ID: $STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID"

# Warmup + Detonate
"$STRATUS_BIN" detonate gcp.initial-access.use-compute-sa-outside-gcp
EXIT_CODE=$?

echo "[INFO] Detonation complete: exit=$EXIT_CODE technique=gcp.initial-access.use-compute-sa-outside-gcp"
# Emit structured result
echo "MORGANA_RESULT_METADATA={\"provider\":\"stratus-red-team\",\"technique_id\":\"gcp.initial-access.use-compute-sa-outside-gcp\",\"correlation_id\":\"$STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID\",\"exit_code\":$EXIT_CODE}"
exit $EXIT_CODE
scripts.cleanup_command:
# Stratus Red Team cleanup — uses SAME correlation ID as detonation
# MORGANA_TEST_ID must match the value used during detonate
STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID="${MORGANA_TEST_ID:-manual}"
export STRATUS_RED_TEAM_CORRELATION_ID

if command -v stratus >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STRATUS_BIN=stratus
else
  STRATUS_BIN="{{asset:stratus_linux_amd64}}"
fi

"$STRATUS_BIN" cleanup gcp.initial-access.use-compute-sa-outside-gcp
CLEANUP_EXIT=$?
echo "[INFO] Cleanup complete: exit=$CLEANUP_EXIT technique=gcp.initial-access.use-compute-sa-outside-gcp"
exit $CLEANUP_EXIT

source_metadata.detection: Identify when a GCE default service account (*-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com) is used from outside of Google Cloud by analyzing GCP audit logs. The GCE default service account should typically only be used from within Google Cloud (e.g., from a GCE instance). Usage from external IP addresses with non-GCE user agents indicates potentially stolen credentials. Detection criteria: Monitor GCP audit logs where the caller identity matches *-compute@developer.gserviceaccount.com Filter for calls where the caller IP does not belong to Google's IP ranges Exclude calls with user agents containing GCE or gcloud (which indicate legitimate in-cloud usage)
